comment: WebGL player (D-1250..D-1259): StreamingAssets cannot be read with System.IO in a browser, so the content files are fetched at boot into a MemoryContentSource; the IndexedDB-backed save folder is flushed through a jslib.

keySets.name: WebGlNames
keySets.doc: Native plugin name and log formats of the WebGL boot (Ashen.Platform.WebContentLoader, WebFileSystem).

numberSets.name: WebGlLimits
numberSets.doc: How many StreamingAssets files the WebGL boot requests at once.

numberSets.name: WebGlTiming
numberSets.doc: Seconds between IndexedDB flushes of the save folder while the page is running.
